components.name: sysgen
components.role: MVS/CE base build (Sysgen); also carries IBM distribution tapes, see ibm-mvs38j-distribution
components.license_evidence: no LICENSE/COPYING at commit; README has no license statement (grep 2026-11-26)
components.pinned_by: OSE-002 base pin (HEAD of main on 2026-11-26)
components.notes: Pins its mvslovers products with sha256 in mvslovers.conf. Does not pin Hercules (README l.10 '>= 4.5' only) or MVP (sysgen.py l.2734).

components.name: ibm-mvs38j-distribution
components.role: IBM MVS 3.7 starter system and MVS 3.8j distribution tapes, plus usermod and PTF tapes (sysgen tape/)
components.version: as bundled in sysgen tape/ (44 MB)
components.license_evidence: tape/README.md: downloaded from jaymoseley.com installMVS; origin 'CBT MVS Utilitys Tape CD-ROM 5 dated 2000-12-6'. No rights statement.
components.notes: OSE must not redistribute these or images built from them until the human resolves rights (spec section 2). Commonly described as public domain; not verified.

components.name: mvp
components.role: MVS/CE package manager; packages are bundled in the repo (packages/)
components.license_evidence: no LICENSE/COPYING at commit; README has no license statement
components.pinned_by: OSE-002 (sysgen clones MVP unpinned; enforcing this pin needs sysgen patch P-01)
components.notes: sysgen git_clone() runs 'git pull --ff-only' on an existing clone without ref (sysgen.py l.3247), so a pre-staged detached checkout fails. A wrapper cannot pin it without P-01.

components.name: hercules
components.license_evidence: COPYRIGHT@ee86c4de: 'Hercules may be distributed under the terms of the Q Public License Version 1.0'; LICENSES/ directory not yet read
components.notes: Built from source on the host; OSE does not redistribute binaries. The QPL redistribution conditions (patches distributed separately) have not been reviewed in detail.

components.name: hercules-helper
components.role: host build script for SDL Hercules (recommended by sysgen README l.107)
components.notes: Must be configured to build the pinned Hercules tag, not its default branch; OSE-003 verifies.

components.name: ftpd
components.notes: Annotated tag object c17a07ff; commit shown.

components.name: httpd

components.name: mvsmf
components.role: z/OSMF-style REST API on HTTPD (alternate UFS and dataset access path)
components.notes: Annotated tag object b6d15236. Hash not in upstream SHA256SUMS; reproduced here.

components.name: sdsf
components.license_evidence: no LICENSE/COPYING at commit; README has no license statement; dist tarball has no license file

components.name: ufsd-utils
components.role: host tool that builds UFS disk images (sysgen step 12a); not installed on MVS
components.license_evidence: README.md@78a1c8af 'License: MIT' (l.71-73); no LICENSE file in repo

components.name: cc370

components.notes: Annotated tag object a63d9512. Newest tag on 2026-11-26 is also v1.6.3. Whether compiled OSE output carries GPL obligations (libgcc-like support code) is an open question in the licensing note.

components.name: mbt
components.role: MVS build tool (host compile, link, package, deploy)
components.license_evidence: no LICENSE/COPYING at commit; README has no license statement
components.pinned_by: ADR-0005 (proposed): ufsd mbt.toml@1a63bf52 'mbt = "3.0"'; newest 3.0.x is v3.0.1
